title: Leave a gap between curtain and wall
text: Leave a gap between curtain and wall. I like to simplistic, rustic look of the chain shower curtain hooks, but they are not easy to install, and they do not work smoothly.  The action is kind of jerky and it’s difficult to get the curtain to reach the ends of the poles.  They tend to leave a gap between the curtain and the shower wall.
